{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module MobileBackend.OAuth where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Network.URI (URI, parseURI, uriAuthority, uriRegName, uriScheme)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe, isJust)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isSuffixOf)
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock (UTCTime, getCurrentTime, addUTCTime)
import Control.Monad (when, unless)

data Role = RoleUser | RoleAdmin | RoleModerator
  deriving (Show, Eq, Ord, Generic)

data OAuthConfig = OAuthConfig
  { allowedRedirectDomains :: [Text]
  , clientId              :: Text
  , clientSecret          :: Text
  , tokenEndpoint         :: Text
  , authorizeEndpoint     :: Text
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

data Session = Session
  { sessionUserId    :: Text
  , sessionRole      :: Role
  , sessionExpiresAt :: UTCTime
  , sessionNonce     :: Text
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

data AuthRequest = AuthRequest
  { arRedirectUri :: Text
  , arState       :: Text
  , arScope       :: Text
  , arClientId    :: Text
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

data AuthResponse = AuthResponse
  { respCode        :: Int
  , respRedirectTo  :: Maybe Text
  , respError       :: Maybe Text
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

defaultConfig :: OAuthConfig
defaultConfig = OAuthConfig
  { allowedRedirectDomains = ["app.example.com", "mobile.example.com", "dev.example.com"]
  , clientId = "mobile-app-client"
  , clientSecret = "super-secret-key-do-not-share"
  , tokenEndpoint = "https://auth.example.com/token"
  , authorizeEndpoint = "https://auth.example.com/authorize"
  }

-- | Normalize a URI for comparison by lowercasing scheme and host
normalizeUri :: Text -> Text
normalizeUri uri = T.toLower uri

-- | Extract the hostname from a redirect URI
extractHost :: Text -> Maybe Text
extractHost uriText =
  let parsed = parseURI (T.unpack uriText)
  in case parsed of
    Nothing -> Nothing
    Just uri -> case uriAuthority uri of
      Nothing   -> Nothing
      Just auth -> Just (T.pack (uriRegName auth))

-- | Validate that the redirect URI's host matches one of the allowed domains.
-- Uses suffix matching to support subdomains of allowed domains.
validateRedirectDomain :: OAuthConfig -> Text -> Bool
validateRedirectDomain config redirectUri =
  let normalizedUri = normalizeUri redirectUri
      mHost = extractHost normalizedUri
  in case mHost of
    Nothing   -> False
    Just host ->
      let hostStr = T.unpack host
          checkDomain :: Text -> Bool
          checkDomain domain =
            let domainStr = T.unpack domain
            in hostStr == domainStr || ("." ++ domainStr) `isSuffixOf` hostStr
      in any checkDomain (allowedRedirectDomains config)

-- | Validate the scheme is HTTPS (or custom scheme for mobile deep links)
validateScheme :: Text -> Bool
validateScheme uriText =
  let parsed = parseURI (T.unpack uriText)
  in case parsed of
    Nothing  -> False
    Just uri ->
      let scheme = uriScheme uri
      in scheme == "https:" || scheme == "exampleapp:"

-- | Full redirect URI validation pipeline
validateRedirectUri :: OAuthConfig -> Text -> Either Text Text
validateRedirectUri config redirectUri = do
  let normalized = normalizeUri redirectUri
  if not (validateScheme redirectUri)
    then Left "Invalid scheme: must be https or exampleapp"
    else if not (validateRedirectDomain config normalized)
      then Left "Redirect domain not in allowlist"
      else Right normalized

-- | Check if user has required role for the requested scope
checkScopePermission :: Role -> Text -> Bool
checkScopePermission RoleAdmin _          = True
checkScopePermission RoleModerator scope  = scope /= "admin:write"
checkScopePermission RoleUser scope       = scope `elem` ["read", "profile", "openid"]

-- | Process an OAuth authorization request
processAuthRequest :: OAuthConfig -> Maybe Session -> AuthRequest -> AuthResponse
processAuthRequest config mSession req =
  case mSession of
    Nothing -> AuthResponse 401 Nothing (Just "Authentication required")
    Just session ->
      if not (checkScopePermission (sessionRole session) (arScope req))
        then AuthResponse 403 Nothing (Just "Insufficient permissions for requested scope")
        else case validateRedirectUri config (arRedirectUri req) of
          Left err -> AuthResponse 400 Nothing (Just err)
          Right validUri ->
            let callbackUrl = validUri <> "?code=AUTH_CODE_" <> sessionUserId session
                                      <> "&state=" <> arState req
            in AuthResponse 302 (Just callbackUrl) Nothing

-- | Handle the token exchange endpoint
handleTokenExchange :: OAuthConfig -> Text -> Text -> Text -> Either Text (Text, Role)
handleTokenExchange config code redirectUri clientSecret' =
  if clientSecret' /= clientSecret config
    then Left "Invalid client credentials"
    else case validateRedirectUri config redirectUri of
      Left err -> Left err
      Right _  ->
        if "AUTH_CODE_" `T.isPrefixOf` code
          then let userId = T.drop 10 code
               in Right (userId, RoleUser)
          else Left "Invalid authorization code"

-- | Mobile deep link redirect handler - validates and redirects
mobileRedirectHandler :: OAuthConfig -> Maybe Session -> Text -> Text -> AuthResponse
mobileRedirectHandler config mSession targetUri state =
  let req = AuthRequest
        { arRedirectUri = targetUri
        , arState = state
        , arScope = "openid"
        , arClientId = clientId config
        }
  in processAuthRequest config mSession req
